test_title: English Language and Comprehension Mock Test 54

questions.question: Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word from the options given below. His furtive glance at the documents did not go unnoticed.
Complete the sentence with suitable adverb.Kriti was _ done with her work, when the cafe _ started to empty.
Complete the sentence with suitable verb.Her sketchy background had the potential of _ the reputation of their new law firm.

Fill in the blank with the most appropriate article. If no article is required, choose ‘no article’.The committee has finally approved ___ plan that was proposed during the emergency meeting held last month.
Select the most appropriate proverb to substitute the underlined group of words in the given sentence.After receiving a promotion, he began to brag about his success constantly.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (blow his own trumpet) है।

questions.question: Identify and correct the incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence.Despite his benevolant, affectionate, gregarious, and humorous nature, he often felt lonely.
Choose the option which best replaces the underlined text.He was declared innocent because the charges against him were based on false information.
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word from the options given below. The teacher praised her for her assiduous efforts in completing the project.
Substitute the highlighted phrase with one word.His not showing enough care and attention towards his ageing parents spells his ungratefulness if not anything else!
Complete the sentence with suitable articles. Use X where no article is required.This is _ horrendous situation to which _ authorities do not seem to have _ solution to.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (a; the; a) है।

questions.question: Identify and correct the incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence.The report was comprehensive, miscellanious, detailed, and informative, covering every aspect of the policy.
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. The principal insisted ___ maintaining strict discipline within the school premises.

Comprehension: Read the given passage carefully and answer the following questions.India could experience 30 fewer extremely hot days each year, while the world on average could avoid such 57 such days if countries meet their emission- cutting pledges under the 2015 Paris Agreement and limit global warming to 2.6 degrees Celsius this century, according to a new study published on Thursday.The analysis by Climate Central and World Weather Attribution said the global accord, which completes 10 years this year, is steering the world toward a safer climate but warned that the current pace of action is not enough. Even at 2.6 degree Celsius, scientists caution, future generations will face heat, severe health risks and growing inequality unless countries move faster to phase out fossil fuels. India could experience 30 fewer hot days a year, while Kenya could see 82 fewer, Mexico 77, Brazil 69, Egypt 36 and the US and the UK 30 and 29 respectively, the researchers said.Prof Friederike Otto, Professor in Climate Science at Imperial College London, said, “The Paris Agreement is a powerful, legally binding framework that can help us avoid the most severe impacts of climate change. However, countries need to more to shift away from oil, gas and coal. We have all the knowledge and technology needed to transition away from fossil fuels but stronger, fairer policies are needed to move faster.”“Political leaders need to take the reason for the Paris Agreement much more seriously. It is about protecting our human rights.” she added.According to the study mentioned, approximately how many fewer extremely hot days could the world on average avoid each year if the 2.6-degree Celsius warming limit is met?

Even at 2.6 degree Celsius, scientists caution, future generations will face heat, severe health risks and growing inequality unless countries move faster to phase out fossil fuels. India could experience 30 fewer hot days a year, while Kenya could see 82 fewer, Mexico 77, Brazil 69, Egypt 36 and the US and the UK 30 and 29 respectively, the researchers said.Prof Friederike Otto, Professor in Climate Science at Imperial College London, said, “The Paris Agreement is a powerful, legally binding framework that can help us avoid the most severe impacts of climate change. It is about protecting our human rights.” she added.What inference can be drawn about the current state of global climate action?
options: Future generations will face severe health risks only in countries that did not sign the Paris Agreement.
The Paris Agreement is failing and has had no measurable positive effect on global warming.
The recent international efforts have stabilized the climate, and no further action on fossil fuels is necessary.
While the Paris Agreement is effective, the rate at which countries are meeting the pledges is currently too slow to avoid serious long-term consequences.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (While the Paris Agreement is effective, the rate at which countries are meeting the pledges is currently too slow to avoid serious long-term consequences.) है।

questions.question: Substitute the following word segment with suitable proverb.If you keep asking your child what she is doing every hour of the day, it is not helping her in any way. As they say instead of checking something constantly, you should just give it time to get done.
options: beauty is in the eye of the beholder
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (a watched pot never boils) है।

questions.question: Which one-word term is used to describe an animal or person that prefers to live, move, or associate in groups rather than in isolation, exhibiting a natural inclination for companionship or social interaction?
